game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library, a ruined library: the tomb cartographer must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moss Library: a ruined library
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Library, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round, a new chalk marks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 210 points of chalk marks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 210, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Moss Library'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Moss Library.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 210 within 63 seconds.
